site.name: BDH Research
site.description: BDH (Baby Dragon Hatchling) is a research project exploring brain-inspired neural architectures: linear attention, Hebbian learning, and multi-scale memory for efficient, interpretable AGI.

hero.headline: Architecting the Singularity
hero.subheadline: BDH replaces quadratic attention with O(N) linear attention, Hebbian state matrices, and multi-scale memory — a fundamentally different approach to sequence modeling inspired by biological neural circuits.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: BDH rethinks the transformer from first principles. Instead of comparing every token to every other token, it accumulates knowledge in a Hebbian state matrix that grows linearly with sequence length.

components.name: Linear Attention
components.description: O(N) complexity via matrix associativity: Q(KᵀV) instead of (QKᵀ)V
components.technical_detail: Eliminates the O(N²) softmax bottleneck. Trades competitive selection for efficient accumulation.

components.name: Hebbian State Matrix
components.description: Working memory via local learning rule: E(t+1) = γ·E(t) + η·(Q⊗V)
components.technical_detail: Neurons that fire together wire together. The state matrix accumulates query-value associations over time with exponential decay.

components.name: Multi-Scale Memory
components.technical_detail: Maps to biological memory systems: short-term plasticity, early LTP, late LTP. Weighted combination extends effective context ~4× over single-scale.

components.name: Multiplicative Gating
components.description: Residual modulation: output = x × sigmoid(attn + ffn)
components.technical_detail: Unlike additive residuals in all other architectures, multiplicative gating implements neuromodulation — the model controls its own information flow.

components.name: ReLU Sparsity
components.description: ~5% active neurons via ReLU in FFN layers
components.technical_detail: Biologically inspired sparse activations. Creates emergent modularity and energy efficiency. Enables future sparse GPU kernel optimization.

components.name: RYS Surgery
components.technical_detail: Enables stable warm-starts for deeper models by duplicating layers and adding infinitesimal noise, preserving learned distributions while increasing capacity.

components.name: Mimetic Initialization
components.technical_detail: Weights are initialized to mimic the gradient flow and activation statistics of a larger teacher model, significantly reducing early training instability in distilled models.

components.name: Byte-Level Processing
components.description: No tokenizer required — processes raw bytes (vocab=256)
components.technical_detail: Universal, language-agnostic input. No OOV tokens. BBPE tokenizer (vocab=8192) available as optional optimization for 2.75× speedup.

architecture.diagram_description: Input tokens flow through embedding → LayerNorm → MultiScaleLinearAttention (computes Q(KᵀV), updates Hebbian state) → LayerNorm → ReLULowRankFFN → Multiplicative Gating combines attention and FFN outputs → Output. Three parallel Hebbian states (fast/medium/slow) are combined with weights 0.2/0.3/0.5.

agi_pathway.title: AGI Pathway
agi_pathway.description: BDH is designed as the foundation for recursive, self-improving intelligence.

milestones.name: Meta-Cognition
milestones.description: Recursive monitoring of internal states to identify and correct reasoning errors in real-time.

milestones.name: Self-Play Distillation
milestones.description: A feedback loop where the model generates training data for itself, driving recursive intelligence gains.

milestones.name: Goal-Directed Exploration
milestones.description: Active hypothesis testing within the latent space to navigate towards user-defined goals.

milestones.name: Architectural Singularity
milestones.description: The point where the model optimizes its own architectural parameters to exceed human design capabilities.

features.title: Linear Scaling
features.description: Attention cost grows linearly with sequence length, not quadratically. Enables processing of much longer sequences than standard transformers.

features.title: Fixed Memory
features.description: Constant O(d²) working memory regardless of sequence length. No growing KV cache.

features.title: Interpretable States
features.description: The Hebbian state matrix is directly readable — each entry encodes an association between dimensions. No post-hoc analysis needed.

features.title: Biologically Grounded
features.description: Hebbian learning, multi-scale memory, sparse activations, and neuromodulatory gating — all inspired by known brain mechanisms.

features.title: Knowledge Distillation
features.description: Training pipeline supports distillation from larger models (TinyLlama, Qwen, Gemma) for accelerated learning.

features.title: Open Research
features.description: Fully open-source implementation. All code, configs, and research documentation publicly available.

papers.title: The Dragon Hatchling: The Missing Link Between the Transformer and Models of the Brain
papers.summary: Original BDH paper. Introduces the architecture, biological motivation, and initial results. Claims Transformer-like performance at 10M-1B parameter range with O(N) complexity.

status.current_state: Research prototype — core architecture implemented, training pipeline functional, scaling and benchmarking in progress.
what_in_progress: Local convolution (causal Conv1d before linear attention)
what_planned: Hebbian state as content-dependent selection index
